labelledBy: hand-written and hand-labelled by the M2 implementer on 2026-09-28; one person, not second-checked. Mode labels are a judgement, not ground truth mined from git.

modes.symbol: the answer is one named declaration (function, class, type, constant)
modes.grep: the answer is a line of text: a message, a comment, a setting or a literal value
modes.path: the answer is a file or folder, not a line inside it
modes.semantic: a behaviour or concept described with none of the words its code uses
modes.hybrid: a short noun phrase that could be a file, a symbol or text
